About Us
========

Pan-Latin Cuisine & Cocktails in Wicker Park
--------------------------------------------

At Amaru, we share our culture, history and passion for Latin American food and warm hospitality with you. We have multinational influences from the Argentinian wine country to the seafood-abundant waters of Peru; the Amazonian jungles of Brazil to the verdant mountains of Colombia; with the diversity of Mexico and the spirit of the Caribbean.

[Read more about us](https://amaruchicago.com/chicago-wicker-park-amaru-about#)

Order Online
============

Savor Convenience, Savor Delight
--------------------------------

Enjoy gourmet delights delivered straight to your doorstep with our simple online ordering system. Satisfy your cravings with ease and convenience.

We have multinational influences from the Argentinian wine country to the seafood-abundant waters of Peru; the Amazonian jungles of Brazil to the verdant mountains of Colombia; with the diversity of Mexico and the spirit of the Caribbean.

Monday-Thursday 5:00 PM - 6:00 PM | Sunday 4:00 PM - 5:00 PM • Not available on Holidays.

Cocktails
---------

### Coquito

$7.00

Traditional Puerto Rican Coquito shot blends Coconuts, white rum, assorted milks, vanilla, and a subtle touch of cinnamon for a silky, holiday-inspired sip.

### Mojito

$10.00

Amaru’s rum, lime juice, mint.

### Caipirinha

$10.00

Cachaça, lime, simple syrup.

### Pedro Navajas

$10.00

Dark Rum, Sfumato, Fino Sherry, Orgeat, Lime

### Oiga, mire, vea

$10.00

White Rum, Falernum, Passion Fruit, Orgeat

### Piña Colada

$10.00

White & Dark Rum, Coconut Cream, Pineapple, Lime

### La Consentida

$10.00

Tequila Traditional Silver , Orange Liquor, Lime, Hibiscus

$10.00

Sweet plantains, and chorizo, wrapped in bacon.

$7.00

Coconut rice, green beans, roasted corn, soft poached egg.

### Yuca Frita

$6.00

Yuca, mojo verde aioli.

### Shrimp Chicharron

$12.00

Crispy rock shrimp, chile morita aji dulce, herbs.

### Solterito

$8.00
